question: How does q_a geodesic noise degrade the omega-grid + local-window surrogate-MSE cost surface's ability to rank truth-omega?
hypothesis: The omega-grid cost surface stays discriminative for truth-omega up to the realistic cloud-quantization q_a noise (~10deg).
narrative_md: q_a-noise sensitivity sweep of the omega-grid cost surface on seed 28 (T_A=25): truth-omega stays in top-16 up to ~7.5deg q_a noise; at 10deg it is bimodal (1/3 trials rank 1, 2/3 rank ~165); at 15deg it fails (rank 128-422). The realistic SO(3) survival-cloud quantization puts the closest-to-truth member at 10.96deg -- exactly the bimodal cliff, so the proposed s059j architecture is borderline operational at current density (~33% success). Uses perturbed-truth q_a + truth-omega grid -- oracle-leak, N=1.
